summary: Iteration 87 (reactions / in-chat search / drafts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing in test_iteration87_reactions_search_drafts.py; iter85 + iter86 regression 37/37 still green. Frontend (390x844, viewer2): double-tap on last own bubble toggles ❤️ reaction (add/remove), reactions-row appears with ❤️; tapping the row opens reactors-sheet showing 'Reacciones · 1', tab '❤️ 1', row 'Tú' with 'Quitar reacción' — clicking Quitar reacción closes the sheet and clears the row. Live update: newtest REST reacts with 😂 → viewer2's open chat shows reactions-row updated to '😂' within ~2s via WS message_reaction. Chat search: magnifier opens bar, 'creó el grupo' → 1 result, counter '1/1', click loads older history and adds .bubble-flash on #bubble-<id>; 'iter86' → 14 results with prev/next arrows visible+enabled; 'zzzzqqq' shows 'Sin resultados'; close hides the bar. Drafts: typing 'borrador QA' persists in localStorage bruno_draft_<chatId>, ChatList shows chat-draft-preview 'Borrador: borrador QA', re-opening restores textarea; page reload on /chat/<id> restores; pressing Enter sends and clears both localStorage and the preview; per-chat isolation confirmed (draft-A visible only in chat A, chat B empty, back to A restores).

issues: When calling pill-send-btn.click(force=True) from Playwright a 'Mensajes' side-panel overlay sometimes intercepts the click instead of sending; pressing Enter on the textarea sends reliably. Not user-facing (real users use Enter or tap on the mobile). Might indicate the send button's hit area is beneath a floating panel at 390px in some states.

critical_code_review_comments: chat_extras.search_messages runs one count_documents per result to compute offset (O(N) round-trips). For a search with many results this is slow; consider computing offsets client-side from a single sorted fetch or aggregating with $rank.

MessageReactionsBubble.handleTap: double-tap detection window 320ms is tight for slow devices; also the outer div is the tap target which grows to include the reactions-row → data-no-dbltap on the row correctly excludes it, but clicking in the small gap between bubble and row could still fire toggle; consider anchoring the double-tap listener to the bubble content only.
react_to_message: emoji is truncated to first 8 chars silently; safer to validate against a whitelist (heart/laugh/…) or reject unknowns with 400 for consistency.
search endpoint does one aggregate $count then N per-result count_documents — a single $facet aggregation would return total + offsets in one round-trip.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for reactions / search / drafts / WS live update

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright double-tap must be simulated with TWO page.mouse.click at the same coords ~120-150ms apart on #bubble-<msg_id> (or [data-testid='msg-<id>']). page.dblclick fires a single 'click' with detail=2 which handleTap treats as one tap → no reaction. When targeting a bubble that already has a reaction from prior runs, dbltap toggles OFF; check the initial reactions-row state first. To send a message from the pill composer prefer textarea.press('Enter') rather than clicking pill-send-btn — the button occasionally sits under a floating chats overlay at 390px. WS reactions come with type='message_reaction'; the client updates messages[].reactions from the payload without a REST re-fetch.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found — behavior matches the spec for all three features.
